description: Implement filter card with all 47 Kenyan counties and functional status filtering. Build county dropdown using allCounties from kenyaAdministrative.ts, functional status dropdown (Functional, Semi-Functional, Non-Functional, Closed). Add Apply Filters and Clear Filters controls. Filter live Supabase tickets data. Display active view indicator and reporting status. Use card-view design with white background and subtle border/shadow.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-002.json to understand requirements
Import allCounties from '../data/kenyaAdministrative' at top of SEMADashboardComplete.tsx

Replace existing filters card section (lines ~172-240) with new implementation: County dropdown showing 'All counties' plus all 47 counties from allCounties.map(c => c.name), Status dropdown showing 'All functional statuses', 'Functional', 'Semi-Functional', 'Non-Functional', 'Closed'

Implement filter state management: useState for selectedCounty, selectedStatus, showCountyDropdown, showStatusDropdown. Filter tickets array using: county match (ticket.county === selectedCounty or 'All counties'), status match (map ticket statuses: 'open'/'pending' → 'Functional', 'in-progress' → 'Semi-Functional', 'closed'/'resolved' → count separately)

Add Apply Filters button (gray background, Filter icon from Lucide) that calls refetch() from useTickets hook. Add Clear filters link (blue text) that resets both dropdowns to 'All' and calls refetch()
Display active view indicator: 'All counties • All functional statuses' or show selected values. Display 'Reporting: Latest available' text below filters
Style filter card: white bg-white, rounded-lg, shadow-sm, border border-gray-200, p-6 padding, dropdowns with ChevronDown icons, matching DHA government portal aesthetic
acceptance_criteria: County dropdown lists all 47 Kenyan counties from allCounties data source
Status dropdown shows all functional status options as specified in requirements
Apply Filters button triggers data refetch and filters tickets by selected county and status
Clear Filters resets both dropdowns to 'All' and shows complete unfiltered dataset
Active view indicator accurately reflects current filter selections
Filter card uses card-view design: white background, rounded corners, shadow, proper spacing
verification: npm run build:check passes with no TypeScript errors
Start dev server, login, verify filter card appears below hero section
Click county dropdown - see all 47 counties listed alphabetically with 'All counties' at top
Select a specific county (e.g., Nairobi) and click Apply Filters - verify stats update to show only that county's data
Select functional status filter and verify it filters tickets correctly
Click Clear Filters - verify both dropdowns reset to 'All' and full data shows
Verify active view indicator text updates correctly as filters change
